# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.

I need to exchange a T-shirt — the one I have is blue, size S, polyester, v-neck — and I want to switch it to a red one, size XXL, cotton, crew neck. Also, I want to use the gift card for it.

I’m not totally sure if that counts as a straight exchange or like… an exchange-plus-difference situation, since basically everything about the shirt is changing except that it’s still a T-shirt. Could you help me figure that out?

I can help, but first I need to verify your identity before I can look up the order.

Please provide either:
- the email on the account, or
- your last name + zip code

Since you already gave your name, the fastest option is your zip code.

Oh sure — the email on the account should be amelia.gonzalez4271@example.com.

I was about to give the zip, but then I realized I might be mixing up my shipping zip and my billing zip, and I don’t want to accidentally verify as some alternate version of myself, if that makes sense. So the email is probably safer.
amelia_gonzalez_4098
